# GOVP

> GOVP is the open protocol for portable, independently verifiable operational evidence.

Version: 0.1.10
Protocol: GOVP-1 (stable)
Install: python -m pip install govp==0.1.10
PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/govp/0.1.10/
Release: https://github.com/govp-protocol/govp/releases/tag/v0.1.10
Canonical source: https://github.com/govp-protocol/govp
Release source commit: 84a096836c409a0aa45e7511d80f6e4c871091ca
License: Apache-2.0

Primary documentation:
- https://govp.io/govp/spec/govp-1.txt
- https://govp.io/govp/docs.html
- https://govp.io/govp/composition.html
- https://govp.io/govp/conformance/vectors.json
- https://govp.io/govp/conformance/json-vectors.json
- https://govp.io/govp/schemas/govp-1.schema.json
- https://govp.io/PROTOCOL-SOURCE.json
- https://govp.io/.well-known/govp.txt

Interpretation boundary: GOVP verifies record signature and integrity. When the asset is an upstream evidence object, GOVP binds its exact bytes but does not replace that system's native verification or policy.
